title: Ending epilogue states 'In the Vale the barrow doors stay shut, as you promised' even though I explicitly chose 'decline to promise' when the reeve first offered (t7-9); I only sealed the doors later as a free, unprompted choice at the throne. The text asserts a promise that was never made.
where: Marrowgate/Hollow Throne ending screen, re: Last Light Square reeve dialogue
